name: Apartment Haselsberger
beschreibung: Apartment Haselsberger is centrally located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, a peaceful village in the Kaiser Valley. The holiday apartment is functionally furnished in a classic alpine style. Cable cars and hiking trails can be reached on foot in just a few minutes. Restaurants and a supermarket are available in town. The accommodation is well suited for self-catering guests looking to actively explore the Tyrol region.
